current.text: He is a projected starter at guard, next to Desmond Bane, Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero and Wendell Carter Jr.
Orlando has a new head coach, Sean Sweeney, so his role and minutes may change.
Orlando is 2.5 million USD under the second apron and will likely have to choose between keeping Suggs and keeping Anthony Black.
One expert thinks Suggs is the likely trade sacrifice to keep Black.
Experts say drafts have him far too low. He could be a top 70 to 80 player if he plays about 65 games, and ESPN's rank of 143 is called silly.
Experts disagree on whether to draft him. Most call him worth the shot at his price, but one would pass because of his injury history, and another is not confident he will reach 65 games.
Plan for him to miss about 20 games this season.
He went for 9 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
A healthy offseason could unlock another level after his career high in assists last season.
One expert projects Orlando for 47 or 48 wins and the 6th seed.
Orlando plays 11 games in our playoff weeks (3-4-4) and has 14 back-to-backs. The schedule is called unremarkable.

durable.text: His all-out, physical playing style gets his body beaten up and leads to repeated injuries and missed games. Experts compare him to Alex Caruso.
Availability is his main issue. Experts say he would rank much higher without the injury concerns.
His per-game line is strong, led by steals and assists.
Steals are a league outlier. He is projected for about 1.6 per game.
His three-point shooting is streaky. When it is on, he takes about six threes a game.

note: Experts rate him a top 70 to 80 player per game if he stays healthy, but the market is pricing him for his injuries: Yahoo has him at 5 USD (rank 95), ESPN at 0 USD (rank 143), and he went for 1 USD in our league last season. At 5 to 9 USD he is a cheap source of steals, assists and threes for guard-heavy builds, but his FG% (43.5 on about 11 attempts) and turnovers are slightly below average, and you should plan for him to miss about 20 games. Early in the season, check how new coach Sean Sweeney uses him and whether Orlando's apron squeeze leads to a Suggs trade.
